items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: But Max is steady as a jazz booker and I think the guys respect him for that.

ctx.x: But Max is steady as a jazz booker and I think the guys respect him for that. When jazz wasn't doing so well, a few years back, he still tried to keep fellas like Charlie Shavers and Roy Eldridge, everybody, tried to keep them working --
